'''Tiktaalik''' is an [[extinct]] [[amphibious]] large fish from the [[wikipedia:Devonian|Devonian]] era, found in [[savage]] [[tropical]] freshwater.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] tiktaalik for their ''affinity for land'' and ''fins''.
